360K likes, 9,381 comments - chatgpt on September 3, 2026: "We’re introducing GPT‑6 Astra, the world’s most intelligent and aligned model.

GPT‑6 Astra brings together years of research and big bets across pre-training, reinforcement learning, and alignment. Astra is state-of-the-art on computer use, browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, science, and professional work. Astra saturates FrontierMath Tier 4 with a 98% score, having already helped sole long-standing open problems in mathematics. 

Astra also saturates ARC-AGI-3 with a 99.9% score and ExploitBench with a 100% score. It sets a new frontier on computer and browser use, handling the most demanding professional work with unmatched speed, accuracy, and judgment.

Astra is our most aligned model, with substantial improvements in understanding user intent and model behavior—you can delegate tasks with greater confidence in Astra’s judgment. As one way that we test this, we built a new evaluation informed by the Hugging Face incident that evaluates whether a model facing a difficult or impossible task will go beyond its intended scope. Compared to GPT‑5.6 Sol, which without production safeguards went beyond the authorized target 48% of the time, GPT‑6 Astra did this in 0% of cases.

GPT‑6 Astra is rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days will become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS.

Read more about it at the link in our bio.

"Put That There" clip courtesy of MIT Media Laboratory, Chris Schmandt, and Eric Hulteen.".

32K likes, 1,385 comments - chatgpt on July 9, 2026: "This is the new ChatGPT Work.

Powered Codex and GPT-5.6, it’s a whole new way to get work done.

It can now understand your goals, use context from selected apps and files, create polished documents, decks, analyses, sites, and reports, and keep work moving while you stay in control.

You can just describe the outcome you want without needing to outline every step to get there.

The new ChatGPT desktop app will be available globally starting today to all users on Mac and Windows.

Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users will also be able to use the new experience on web and mobile at launch.".

562 likes, 43 comments - openai on October 31, 2026: "You know how in certain books, the first word starts with a giant, stylized capital letter? As it turns out, those big, fancy letters can be a glitch-causing nightmare for screen-reading programs for the visually-impaired.  
 Jaxsen Day, a visually-impaired PhD student at the University of Texas Austin, says the fancy-letter issue is just one example of the many problems faced by modern accessibility tools.   Jaxsen used ChatGPT and Codex to solve a lot of those issues, building himself custom workflows that assist with everything from making academic research easier to access, to better interpreting funky, poorly-digitized PDFs.  Now, as part of his dissertation, he’s working with Mario Guerra, UT Austin’s Associate Vice President of AI Platforms and Innovation, to use AI to make reading materials more accessible campus-wide.   And the pressure is on: under new federal rules, public universities face an April 2027 deadline to ensure their websites and digital materials—including many academic readings—meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.  Achieving accessibility at a university is far more complex than it sounds. Nearly every department has its own process of storing and digitizing research materials, so accessibility tools need to be as adaptive as their users.   But Jaxsen believes that if he can use ChatGPT and Codex to satisfy his own unique needs, there’s no reason whole departments can’t either. Now Jaxsen’s priority is sharing his AI-based methods campus-wide.   And after Jaxsen’s dissertation is complete? While he’s not exactly sure what’s next, he’s at least confident that it’ll take a lot more than a big, fancy letter to slow him down.".

2,009 likes, 90 comments - excusemygrandma on October 29, 2026: "I tried teaching Grandma Gail how to use @chatgpt with a little help from older New Yorkers at @jasaseniors. It quickly became the world’s most opinionated Zoom class 😂

A few prompts you can try:

• “My grandchild said, ‘You ate. No crumbs.’ Translate that into plain English.”

• “My grandchild is interested in [artist, sport, video game or trend]. Explain what it is and why people enjoy it. Suggest three thoughtful questions I could ask them.”

• “Read the visible text on this [label, menu or instruction sheet] and rewrite it in an easy-to-read format. Mark anything you can’t read instead of guessing.”

• “Help me document a family recipe that I usually make from memory. Ask about the ingredients, measurements and steps one question at a time. Then help me write down the story behind it.”

• “Help me plan a three-day trip to [destination]. Ask me one question at a time about our budget, interests, travel dates and walking or transportation needs.”

#ChatGPT_Partner".

5,786 likes, 161 comments - benjaminuyeda on October 23, 2026: "There is a big difference between renderings from 3d models and image generation from a strictly text prompt. Renderings are fun to look at but if the underlying geometry is off, they can be misleading during a design process. For my new house I started by drawing a floorplan and elevations while labeling the major dimensions.  I took photos of these 2d drawings and had @chatgpt build me a 3d model in blender with this prompt:

“Use this floorplan and elevation drawings to reconstruct my house as an editable, dimensionally controlled Blender model.
First identify the drawing revisions and extract the dimensions needed for the model. Cite the source sheet for each dimension, distinguish documented values from calculated values, and flag missing or conflicting information.
Build the architectural shell first. Preserve the documented layout, roof geometry, and opening locations. Produce plan overlays, elevations, sections, and a numerical dimension comparison before adding finishes.
After resolving discrepancies, add materials and furnishings and render all views from the same saved model. Deliver the editable model, dimension record, unresolved-items list, verification views, and final renderings.”

Blender is free to download, and you can check the model to make sure the design is what you want. @chatgpt can make changes for you and produce floorplan options and renderings. These renderings are a bit basic, but the geometry can be checked. If you want to upgrade the renderings you can give those simple rendering to @chatgpt tell it to keep the buildings geometry the same but add more photorealistic materials and elements. AI can do a lot of digital tasks, but critical decisions should be made in consultations with experienced building professionals. #chatgpt_partner".
